#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 7



list_labels_descriptives_by_demogroup <- targets::tar_read(initial_settings)$labels_list[c( "hivPrep", "monkeypoxVaccine", "sexOrientation")]

list_labels_descriptives_by_demogroup[["stratum"]] <- list()
list_labels_descriptives_by_demogroup[["stratum"]][["levels"]] <- list()

list_labels_descriptives_by_demogroup[["stratum"]][["levels"]][["white-cisgender-man"]]  <- "White\nCisgender\nMan"
list_labels_descriptives_by_demogroup[["stratum"]][["levels"]][["latinx-cisgender-man"]] <- "Latinx\nCisgender\nMan"
list_labels_descriptives_by_demogroup[["stratum"]][["levels"]][["black-cisgender-man"]]  <- "Black\nCisgender\nMan"
list_labels_descriptives_by_demogroup[["stratum"]][["levels"]][["other-cisgender-man"]]  <- "Other\nCisgender\nMan"
list_labels_descriptives_by_demogroup[["stratum"]][["levels"]][["non-binary"]]           <- "Non-Binary\nPerson"
list_labels_descriptives_by_demogroup[["stratum"]][["levels"]][["transgender-man"]]      <- "Transgender\nMan"
list_labels_descriptives_by_demogroup[["stratum"]][["levels"]][["transgender-woman"]]    <- "Transgender\nWoman"
list_labels_descriptives_by_demogroup[["stratum"]][["levels"]][["cisgender-woman"]]      <- "Cisgender\nWoman"
list_labels_descriptives_by_demogroup[["stratum"]][["levels"]][["other"]]                <- "Another\nDemographic"




demo_group_labels <- list_labels_descriptives_by_demogroup[["stratum"]][["levels"]]


local_colors <- mpxnyc_colors$all_colors
names(local_colors) <- NULL


 plot <-  targets::tar_read(participant_data) %>%
    group_by(demo_group) %>%
    summarize(count = n()) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(!is.na(demo_group)) %>%
    mutate(level = demo_group) %>%
    mutate(proportion = count / sum(count)) %>%
    mutate(level = as.character(level)) %>%
    arrange(count) %>%
    mutate(level = as.character(level)) %>%
    mutate(level = factor(level, names(demo_group_labels), demo_group_labels)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(level)) %>%
  ggplot2::ggplot() + 
             ggplot2::theme_void() + 
        ggplot2::geom_bar(aes(x = level, y = proportion, fill = level), width = 1, stat = "identity") + 
       ggplot2::geom_text(aes(x = level, y = proportion + 0.05, label = count), alpha = 0.7) +
          ggplot2::theme(
                          legend.position = "none", 
                          panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_line(size = 0.1),
                          axis.text.x = element_text(),
                          axis.text.y = element_text(),
                          axis.title.y = element_text(angle = 90)
                          ) + 
      ggplot2::scale_x_discrete("", drop = FALSE) +
      ggplot2::scale_y_continuous("Proportion of participants", labels = scales::percent) + 
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = local_colors) +
      ggplot2::theme(
        plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,0, "cm"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(0, 0, 2, 0, "mm")),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(0, 0, 15, 0, "mm")),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(0, 10, 0, 0, "mm")),
        plot.caption = element_text(margin = margin(15, 0, 0, 0), hjust = 0)
      ) +
    labs(
      title    = captions_and_titles("radarracegender")$title,
      subtitle = captions_and_titles("radarracegender")$subtitle,
      caption  = captions_and_titles("radarracegender")$caption %>% str_wrap(110) %>% paste0("\n\n", captions_and_titles("common_caption") )
    ) 
  
     apply_style_spacing_descriptives(plot)
